## Plugin and change

Describe the plugin, its commands, and why this change helps font designers.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tested in Counterplay (version and macOS version below)
- [ ] Declared only necessary permissions and explained them in the README
- [ ] Tested each command/window, empty and large fonts, close/reopen, and persistence

- [ ] Included readable source, README, MIT license, and community.json

Attach screenshots or a short recording and list the actual checks performed.
